name: chungju-minwon-guide
description: 충주시 모바일 민원안내 서비스 (가칭) — 정적 배포용 웹서비스

scripts.build:preview: npm run build:address-index && node scripts/validate-content.mjs && vite build --mode preview
scripts.build:official: npm run build:address-index && node scripts/validate-content.mjs --strict && vite build --mode official && node scripts/verify-official-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:preview && npm run build:official
